ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota DHS Payment Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the cause of the Minnesota DHS payment freeze and its impact on Minnesotans with disabilities.
questions: What is the cause of the payment freeze?
How will the payment freeze affect Minnesotans with disabilities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant issue with the Minnesota DHS's handling of disability payments. By investigating the cause of the payment freeze and its impact on Minnesotans with disabilities, we may be able to shed light on a larger problem and hold those responsible accountable.
